scripts.test:chrome: cross-env BROWSER=chrome npx mocha tests/belajar-bareng --timeout 20000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=reports/json,reportFilename=chrome-report,html=false
scripts.test:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox npx mocha tests/belajar-bareng --timeout 20000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=reports/json,reportFilename=firefox-report,html=false
scripts.test:edge: cross-env BROWSER=MicrosoftEdge npx mocha tests/belajar-bareng --timeout 20000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=reports/json,reportFilename=edge-report,html=false
scripts.test:parallel: concurrently --raw "npm run test:chrome" "npm run test:firefox" "npm run test:edge" && npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
